prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 版本更新日志（中英混排） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "版本" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 43px
  col 2: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "变更内容" · longest unbreakable word 90px · one-line width 646px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，供读者查看版本演进。","reading":"读者可先按版本或日期定位，再扫描类型和变更内容；同一行的元数据与说明需要保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["版本与日期共同标识一次发布，适合并置比较。","类型与变更内容共同说明更新性质；类型是短标签，内容是主要阅读区域。"],"keep_intact":["版本号及其字母、数字和标点","日期中的数字片段","WebSocket、OAuth、OpenSSL 等英文术语及版本号","修复、新功能、性能、安全等类型标签宜尽量保持完整"],"may_wrap":["变更内容可在中文词句及英文术语之间自然换行。","日期可在连字符处换行，但会降低纵向扫描效率。","内容说明形成的行高可容纳同一行中类型或日期的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [64, 108, 67, 120] · table 360×647px · row heights [36, 153, 199, 153, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [63, 107, 37, 149] · table 357×508px · row heights [60, 106, 153, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r0C: widths [64, 64, 67, 164] · table 360×461px · row heights [36, 106, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Constraint adjustments applied: r0B: raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 360px to fit 359px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"版本号、日期和类型均完整显示，表头清楚，发布记录便于纵向定位。","problems":"变更内容过窄，长说明被切成许多短行，尤其第二条更新显得局促；高行中元数据下方留出大片空白，削弱了行内各部分的联系。","cause":"日期列108px足以容纳完整日期，但与67px的类型列一起占用了较多宽度，使内容列只剩120px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"内容列加宽后，说明更容易连续阅读，行高也比r0A紧凑。","problems":"类型表头和标签竖向断开，难以快速扫描；版本号和日期也出现断行，元数据的纵向节奏不稳定。","cause":"类型列只有37px，无法容纳两个汉字；版本列63px、日期列107px也分别比r0A略窄，使部分边界内容折行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"版本号、类型和表头保持完整，内容列较宽，说明的阅读节奏明显优于r0A；各行的元数据仍能与说明对应。","problems":"日期频繁在连字符处分行，最后一条甚至分成三行，削弱了按日期纵向比较的效率；类型列有一些可再分配的空间。","cause":"日期列64px仅有43px内容宽度，不足以容纳完整日期；类型列67px则宽于三字标签所需。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"date-balance","widths":[64,80,67,148],"change":"以r0C为基础加宽日期列，并适度收窄内容列，尝试让日期稳定分成较少的行，同时保留完整类型标签。"},{"name":"content-priority","widths":[64,72,55,168],"change":"将类型列收至仍可容纳三字标签的宽度，给日期比r0C更多空间，并把余量用于变更内容，改善说明的连续阅读。"},{"name":"full-dates","widths":[64,108,55,132],"change":"保留完整日期，将类型列收窄并把节省的宽度分给内容列，测试日期扫描效率与说明行长之间的另一种平衡。"}]}
